content: Web consensus (ClickHouse eng blog, PlanetScale, dev.to 2026): shared schema with tenant_id column + RLS is the default for SaaS; schema-per-tenant causes migration pain and catalog bloat and is only worth it under compliance/enterprise isolation demands; database-per-tenant for regulated workloads. Multi-org membership is modeled with a memberships (user_id, tenant_id, role) join table.
